name: Maeda Tomoaki
source:
Zodiac: Scorpio

3rd year university student. Economics department. Writing a report on Mass Communication. The normal university student becomes a Master/ “Goshujin-sama” as a part-time job. Light brown-dyed hair. Has reasonably good looking features that appeal to women but is not in a relationship with anyone. He likes women but he always loses interest in them when they become closer. He hates clingy types and those who likes to throw tantrums. His sadistic self awakens after he comes to the mansion.
